name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives an AI coding assistant a long-term memory of a project, so it doesn't forget everything it learned yesterday and make you re-explain the same context every single session.
buyer: A developer or small team running long-lived projects with AI coding assistants who's tired of re-explaining project context every new session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer working on a large app over months uses it so the AI assistant remembers past architectural decisions without re-reading the whole codebase each time.
A dev agency managing multiple long-running client codebases uses it to keep each project's AI assistant context isolated and persistent per client.
A team already running the project's own hosted 'Pro' memory tier pays for cross-device, cross-session memory sync instead of self-hosting.

money_ideas.idea: The project already demonstrates this: a hosted 'memory as a service' tier (their own CMEM Pro) that developers pay for instead of self-hosting.
Offer paid onboarding/integration support for larger teams wiring persistent memory into non-standard agent harnesses.

steal_this: This weekend, build a thin wrapper that exports a project's accumulated agent memory as onboarding docs for new hires, turning 'what the AI remembers' into 'what a new engineer needs to know'.
